findings.title: Parameter presence is used as parameter completeness
findings.observed: A real captured package with missing required E and apply-parameters=blocked produced assess.status=Reviewable for ApplyDeclaredParameters because an unrelated Definition materialized and applications>0.
findings.required: Reuse the actual application/parameter-contract binding results and requested-use readiness, preserving relevant obligations; count and materialization are not sufficient.

findings.title: Handoff auxiliary records are only byte-bound
findings.observed: An actual matching package/request was accepted with arbitrary plain text as preparation_assessment, candidate_inventory, open_obligations and note_manifest. Package integrity remains valid; auxiliary type/subject/freshness is not established.
findings.required: Define and consume typed report/manifest contracts, exact subject/use/snapshot correlation and an explicit stale/unknown posture. Keep Lab workspace authority validation outside Define.

findings.title: Reported acknowledgement does not require an actual handoff
findings.observed: Arbitrary text was accepted as handoff and response when response_to equalled its digest. This does not grant acceptance or authenticate the claimed responder.
findings.required: Validate the referenced PreparedHandoff structure, identity/cut and allowed correlation before recording reported acknowledgement. Authenticated consumer identity and effect permission remain with the external owner/host.

findings.title: Field guidance counts references without resolving their selectors
findings.observed: A contribution to /title whose bound JSON source has only /real and whose source_selector is /missing was counted as one valid contribution: missing=[], ambiguous=[]. Final materialization still checks actual full schema/fidelity/lineage.
findings.required: Resolve source/target selections against the selected draft/requirements before treating a field as supplied; distinguish proposals, checked contributions and semantic disagreement.

findings.title: Compiled creation operations are not the normal draft CLI execution path
findings.required: Select one authoritative operation path and route the public creation host through it with real operator resources; retain the existing native authorization/store writer. Shared Python code is not a resurrected Define engine.

findings.title: Workspace effects lack selected custody/store bindings and a qualified production adapter
findings.required: Bind the selected durable workspace to real authority/Project/Work context, custody, store and authenticated permissions. Current Product source reads work; Project-bound effects must not manufacture a semantic Project.

findings.owner: shared Lab coordinator, consuming Define handoff
findings.title: No common resumable handoff-to-publication lifecycle
findings.required: Correlate handoff, draft, semantic-owner disposition, exact proposal/HEAD, signed approval, transaction result and publication receipt; reconcile uncertain outcomes across each boundary.

findings.title: Definition/v2 candidate/local admission is not canonical registry publication
findings.required: Select and authorize a compatible v1/v2 registry/index/human-projection/source transition while preserving admitted historical bytes; Git push and local native commit are not semantic admission.

findings.title: Draft convenience paths prepare new admissions only
findings.required: Expose predecessor-bound revise/withdraw authoring and dependency impacts for Definitions, types, records, ontology and consumers, reusing existing native revision/withdrawal checks.

findings.owner: shared Lab construction governance and consumer generation hosts
findings.title: Full construction gate, owner dispositions and current resource projection remain incomplete
findings.required: Obtain applicable dispositions for five existing unadmitted candidates, prepare a reviewed successor to five obsolete source references, execute six adjacent handoff/freshness gates and independently assess generated outputs. Keep this enforcement outside Define and the generic compiler.
